Option to not rewrite the logging configuration

Enable FastMCP to filter tools, prompts, resources using a fine grained policy

401 in Streamable HTTP should be handled gracefully
OAuth TokenHandler should check Authorization header for client credentials

Using /.well-known/ OAuth endpoints behind custom path on GKE

User-Agent header in sHTTP transport is not forwarded to auth flow

`auth` specification in `ClientSessionGroup`
More control over stderr in stdio client
client's `read_stream_writer` open after SSE disconnection hanging `.receive()`

Support MCP client session resumption (sessionId reuse) in Python SDK
Allow `OAuthClientProvider` to accept a pre-configured auth server URL
Add wildcard pattern support for `allowed_hosts` in transport security

Bug: validate_scope rejects client scopes when required scopes in None

Improve log clarity for "Terminating session: None" in stateless mode

Return 405 on GET when stateless_http=True

raise without from discards exception chain in 12 remaining sites

Expose `schema_generator` on `FastMCP` for tool params schema generation

Duplicate `initialize` with changed parameters can overwrite `ServerSession.client_params`

Add option to skip output validation for mcp client
DCR registration accepts redirect_uris with non-HTTPS / non-loopback / fragmented schemes

`ClientSessionGroup` attempts to use capabilities that were not advertised

Deep JSON-RPC request over stdio logs a validation error and leaves the original request pending
OAuth handler doesn't support redirect URLs with params
`simple-auth` is not working as expected
Bug: anyio.Lock in async_auth_flow causes RuntimeError under concurrent OAuth MCP connections
Invalid JSON-RPC envelope errors are not correlated with the original request id
dict[str, T] tool return types lose Annotated/Field metadata in output schema
StreamableHTTP server accumulates CLOSE_WAIT sockets behind reverse proxy due to missing disconnect cleanup
[Bug] check_capability does not validate elicitation sub-capabilities (form/url)
WWW-Authenticate parsing matches a field name as a substring of another auth-param
FuncMetadata.pre_parse_json mis-detects str | None as non-string and corrupts JSON-looking string arguments
streamable HTTP (stateful): concurrent requests with duplicate JSON-RPC ids cross-wire responses — one request receives another's payload, the other hangs
[v2] RFC 9728 PRM URLs and resource matching drop query components
Heavy sync init work (e.g. local ML models) starves stdio initialize/tool calls even with threadpool offload -- Windows GIL contention
Field alias is published in the tool schema but forwarded as an invalid Python keyword
Generated output schema uses Pydantic's validation shape while structured output uses its serialization shape
RequireAuthMiddleware omits RFC 6750 scope in WWW-Authenticate on 401/403
Streamable HTTP server never returns the spec-mandated 405 for GET requests it won't serve as SSE (406/400 instead) — breaks client SSE-probe fallback
perf: JSONRPCMessage smart union scores all four branches on every inbound message
OAuth client sends client_id in token body under client_secret_basic (strict servers reject as multiple auth methods)
Add `ClientSession.register_tool_schema()` for dynamic tool discovery patterns
Fix Streamable HTTP Accept header quality-factor handling
Bug: OAuth provider holds context.lock for the whole request, so the standalone GET SSE stream stalls the first tools/call by ~15s
OAuth token refresh hits the wrong endpoint when the auth server lives under a path
OAuth client can never recover from an expired DCR client secret — even though the SDK's own server issues and enforces one
OAuthClientProvider._initialize() breaks transparent refresh: missing update_token_expiry + missing oauth_metadata load
`handle_get_stream` reconnects indefinitely when the server ends the GET stream normally (`attempt = 0` defeats `MAX_RECONNECTION_ATTEMPTS`)
streamable_http (legacy mode): early response.aclose() discards a TCP connection per JSON-RPC exchange — deterministic reproduction for #2707
docs: clarify when Client(raise_exceptions=True) actually raises
find_context_parameter treats a Context return annotation as a parameter
check_resource_allowed(): path matching skips dot-segment/percent-encoding normalization (auth-boundary bypass)
resource_url_from_server_url preserves explicit default ports
Streamable HTTP clean EOF reconnects can exceed the request retry budget
A tool returning an empty list produces a CallToolResult with zero content blocks
streamable-http client: no size bound before JSONRPCMessage.model_validate_json — one large server message can OOM the client
Add add_resource_template() to MCPServer

Prompt validation errors are logged with an unnecessary traceback
A tool returning a non-finite float fails on the client with an error naming the tool
Server.call_tool()'s input-validation error result discards jsonschema.ValidationError's structured fields, leaving only free-text prose
Client SSRF / protocol confusion: streamable HTTP transport follows server 3xx into internal+loopback services (follow_redirects=True, no host validation; #2106 closed but fix #2180 never merged)
bug(client/streamable_http): prevent infinite SSE reconnect loops with bounded exponential backoff
pyjwt[crypto] as an unconditional dependency blocks installation on platforms without a cryptography wheel (e.g. Windows on ARM)

ClientSessionGroup raises KeyError when a server exposes no tools, resources or prompts
A tool returning a non-finite float puts invalid JSON in the text content block
Tool input schemas carry a pydantic-derived title on every property
coerce_request_id() folds non-canonical numeric strings, conflating wire-distinct JSON-RPC ids
TransportSecuritySettings.allowed_hosts is compared case-sensitively (NOT RFC 9110 compliant), so an uppercase host entry (the Windows default) rejects every fetch-based client with 421
1.x: streamable_http client leaves a request unresolved when the SSE response stream ends without a response (fixed on 2.x by #3047 — backport request for v1.x)
StdioServerParameters exposes no preexec_fn / rlimit / process-group hook for spawned MCP server subprocess
DNS rebinding :* allowlist matches Host/Origin suffixes that are not ports
check_resource_allowed treats /api/../admin as under /api
StreamableHTTP: a client disconnect while reading the POST body is logged as an exception and answered 500
CallToolResult structuredContent is not alias-normalized to match outputSchema
[v2] Add an end-to-end public-client PKCE server contract
Missing prompt-level _meta support in MCPServer.prompt() and Prompt model
Is one-auth-configuration-per-server a deliberate constraint?
Add SEP-2640 (Skills Extension) protocol support
ClientSessionGroup: a rejected connect_to_server leaves its transport running — the session is established before its components are validated
Streamable HTTP stateless servers hang clients on the listen-mode GET (_handle_get_request opens a hold-open SSE stream)
Streamable HTTP: ASGI application returns before the full SSE body is sent
Does same-origin redirect enforcement break MCP servers behind a reverse proxy?
streamable HTTP client: the standalone GET stream advertises Accept: application/json but can only read text/event-stream, then gives up silently
Revocation requires client_secret to be present
OAuth client: authorization URL is built with a second `?` when the advertised `authorization_endpoint` already carries a query (RFC 6749 §3.1)
ClientSession.call_tool issues a tools/list after every tools/call when the output-schema cache is empty — no opt-out; doubles round-trips on per-call sessions
A tool with a *args or **kwargs parameter is registered with a schema it can never satisfy
A resource template with a non-ASCII or space literal is advertised but can never be read
OAuth client sends discovery/registration requests with no User-Agent, so WAF-fronted servers (Cloudflare) 403 the whole flow
Streamable HTTP client stays closed after an interrupted response and raises ExceptionGroup on cleanup
Server ClientAuthenticator requires client_id in token body, rejecting valid client_secret_basic requests (RFC 6749 §2.3.1)
Streamable HTTP client logs a WARNING for valid 202 Accepted on session termination (DELETE)
How can I manage resource across multiple tool calls during one session?
stdio server ignores the first two Ctrl+C presses at a terminal (blocked stdin worker thread)
Structured tool output: `-> bytes` return crashes with a generic error on non-UTF-8 payloads instead of returning the advertised base64/binary string
Streamable HTTP client treats 404 as terminal instead of re-initializing, as the spec requires
Malformed requests get -32602 where JSON-RPC 2.0 requires -32600 (non-Request body) and -32601 (unknown method)
POST failure identical to task cancellation in streamable HTTP client
[MCPServer] Optional ResourcesAsTools support ala FastMCP
Make Origin validation opt-in in the app factories (keep Host validation on for localhost)
`ClientSessionGroup` has no routed `read_resource` / `get_prompt` (only `call_tool`)
func_metadata raises uncaught PydanticSchemaGenerationError for Iterator/AsyncIterator tool return annotations instead of the unstructured fallback
Tool validation errors echo the rejected input value (input_value) — add a masking option or a public validation-error hook
ClientSessionGroup raises KeyError when connecting a server that exposes no components
OAuthClientProvider: no supported way to override endpoints or customize authorization state generation
Client transports/sessions swallow the original exception; applications cannot classify 401/403/429 transport failures
Image/Audio `format=` emits image/jpg, audio/mp3, audio/m4a — unregistered MIME types that disagree with the `path=` suffix table
DirectoryResource listing uses OS path separators and unstable order
Deploy docs: reused-process runtimes (Lambda) hit the single-use session manager error, but aren't covered
Streamable HTTP client retries the standalone GET after a 401, 403, or 405
Add macos-latest to the CI test matrix
SSE: a POST blocks forever (and SIGTERM hangs) when the server lifespan raises after an await
Streamable HTTP notification triggers duplicate response after HTTP 202
Streamable HTTP client hangs on a null-id JSON-RPC error in a 200 JSON response
ServerCapabilities drops unknown keys, so a server can't advertise `events` for ChatGPT's MCP Events
Prompt handlers returning UserList are rendered as one text message
Tool outputSchema is generated in validation mode, so serialization aliases and computed fields don't match structuredContent
CORSMiddleware on /register and /token forwards any non-preflight OPTIONS request straight to the body-reading handler
Streamable HTTP notification sends a second response when the session writer is closed
MCPServer completion handler returning more than 100 values fails on 2026-07-28 sessions and violates the 100-item limit on 2025-11-25 sessions
